cues.text:
Many voices claim an answer
Many voices point the way

Every voice demands attention
Every fear has more to say

In the middle of confusion
When I do not know the way

Jesus, turn my heart toward You
Help me hear the words You say

When the voices rise
And my hope grows weak

Jesus, be my guide
It's Your truth I seek

Through all the noise
I still hear You calling

Through all the fear
Your truth comes shining through

When voices pull
My heart in many directions

Jesus, my Shepherd
I will follow You

Headlines change and doubts surround me
What seemed certain fades away

But Your word remains forever
You are faithful every day

You are truth amid confusion
You are light upon the way

Jesus, turn my heart toward You
Help me trust the words You say

When the voices rise
And my hope grows weak

Jesus, be my guide
It's Your truth I seek

Through all the noise
I still hear You calling

Through all the fear
Your truth comes shining through

When voices pull
My heart in many directions

Jesus, my Shepherd
I will follow You

Still my heart before You, Lord
Teach me through Your faithful word

You are near, and I am Yours
Lead me, Jesus, all my days

Through all the noise
I still hear You calling

Through all the fear
Your truth comes shining through

When voices pull
My heart in many directions

Jesus, my Shepherd
I will follow You

Jesus, my Shepherd
I will follow You
